newsitem.title: USA: Three Americans said aboard Saudi plane.
newsitem.headline: Three Americans said aboard Saudi plane.

text.p: Three Americans were aboard a Saudi Arabia Airlines plane that collided with another jet over India, killing 349 people, the State Department said on Wednesday.

Deputy spokesman Glyn Davies said two of the Americans were passengers and one was a crew member on the Saudi Boeing 747, which was carrying 312 people. The plane had just taken off from New Delhi on Tuesday when it collided with a Kazakh Ilyushin Il-76 freighter with 37 people on board that was preparing to land.

The State Department did not release names of the three Americans. One family had asked that the information be kept private and in the other two cases the next of kin had not yet been notified, the spokesman said.
